title.narrative: Eastern and Southern African Trade & Development Bank

description.narrative: The Eastern and Southern Africa Trade and Development Bank – TDB Bank – is a regional development bank headquartered in Burundi. It has offices in Nairobi, Harare, and Ebene. Its aim is to facilitate economic growth, trade and regional integration through its role as a financial intermediary providing trade and project finance in 17 countries across East and Southern Africa. It invests in a range of sectors, including agriculture, trade, industry, infrastructure, energy and tourism and provides a range of financial products and services across both the private and public sectors.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: CDC has supported TDB in addressing the short-term financing needs of its clients since 2016. We continued to support TDB during the COVID-19 pandemic. Our commitment in 2020 was made to support private sector corporates in countries with challenging investment climates with working capital. It is, also, expected to benefit the import and export of agricultural products and essential commodities as economies emerge from the COVID-19 crisis.
